content.comment_body: In newer versions of [product_name] (with display), it would be useful if, when programmatically disabling the background light (using specific flags like M25, etc.), pressing the keys adjacent to the screen could still activate the background illumination temporarily. Currently, users need to use an external light source to view the display.
This issue has been present for a long time in the [product_name] modules, and [company_name] is aware of it. However, [company_name] has not addressed or resolved this bug.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have consistently reported difficulties with the backlight functionality on [product_name] (with display) modules, notably the inability to activate the backlight using hardware buttons when the software has turned it off. This affects usability in dim environments and users feel their feedback has not led to improvements, resulting in dissatisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the physical buttons next to the display to provide temporary backlight activation, even if the software has disabled this feature.
